validation.rootTestsNote: Isolated host-root run: DSH_CONTROLS_HOST_ROOT plus the checksum-bound accepted tarball, so no environment-gated host integration case was skipped. A plain node --test without that host seam reports 787 cases with 288 environment-gated skips.
validation.featureEvidence: Two independent read-only audits of the instrument read/consume/inject/delivery face and the write/storage/recovery face ran against v0.4.15 and returned numbered findings with code anchors; the reproduced ones were re-verified in an isolated real-DSH environment before any fix. Fixed: a rejected command could still poison durability because the pre-commit classifier only accepted one error class, so unknown-resource reads, viewer-only history queries and already-cleaned binding updates were reported as unknown persistence outcomes (now ResourceError codes and invalid-state settle as pre-commit, verified end-to-end in an isolated headless session where the rejected reads no longer produce durability-commit-failed); a refresh-gate record stamped the post-mutation epoch, so a mutation landing during an in-flight read certified the pre-mutation projection as current (the gate now stamps the epoch observed before the read); a persistent prologue or representation-boundary failure injected one identical raw-exception notice per step and per tool result (now a stable mechanical reason, retained-session last captured facts when available, and the same baseline/visibility suppression as snapshots); superseded reads are no longer installed as bare unknown snapshots; brief truncation now carries whole-value digests so changes past the shown prefix, the first eight array rows or the first 32 fields are not lost; history re-capture no longer scans every retained row per observation; the consumption cache and snapshot baselines are bounded and pruned on session disposal; authored value arrays carry element budgets; capability/health briefs no longer advertise a query locator that returns an empty notRecorded page.

review.independentReview: two separate read-only audit agents (not the implementing session) inspected the read and write faces and returned anchored findings; every accepted finding was traced in code and, for the reproduced ones, locked by a red/green repository test or an isolated real-DSH run; no external human reviewer
